conclusions: The migrated LookM implementation preserves the inspected original LookM functions exactly at AST level; whole-file bytes differ because of packaging/import transformations.

LookM uses floor(0.1 * full_prefill_input_length) historical positions plus a 32-position recent window per native KV head. BUDGET=1024 and constructor max_capacity_prompt=2048 do not make this a fixed-1024/fixed-2048 policy: update_kv overwrites select_num from the current prompt length.

HybridKV+KVRepack uses a nominal global historical budget based on 112 * floor(0.1 * full_prefill_input_length), heterogeneous native-head allocation, and a recent window of 32 + input_length % 8 per head. Rounding, clipping and head allocation mean actual activity must be measured.

A common nominal 10% setting is reproducible, but neither method has an exact 10% total active cache once its recent window is included. Active attention-cache slots must be distinguished from Hybrid retrieval backing storage and total GPU memory.

LookM creates a fresh prompt-specific cluster and current masks on every prefill; its ratio/config defaults persist in the attention config, so a method/ratio-changing benchmark should use independent model processes or explicitly reset those config fields.

The surviving source snapshot proves a Qwen7B LookM 10%/64-frame/200-example entry existed. The targeted current-tree searches did not find a readable completed LookM7B result/run log; this is not proof the old experiment never ran.

reference_entrypoint.runtime_import_limit: This snapshot sets no PYTHONPATH or working-directory guard. Historical effective import sources require runtime evidence; the inspected migration is source-pinned separately.

call_chain.target: native transformers Qwen2_5_VLForConditionalGeneration with patched Model/TextModel/DecoderLayer/FlashAttention2, not the Hybrid custom model class

lookm_budget.length_definition: N = full prefill q_len, including expanded visual tokens, natural text and special tokens; not visual-token count alone.

not_a_fixed_token_budget.explanation: select_num initially capacity-window; the active update overwrites it with int(q_len*budget_ratio). BUDGET is still required by init_lookm int(os.getenv("BUDGET")) on first initialization.

lookm_budget.text_priority: Historical text attention scores receive each-head max-score boost before topk. Text positions compete within k; no separate unbounded all-text retention is appended.
lookm_budget.recent_window_values: The recent32 positions remain in the output slots. In pivot-merge layers dropped history can be scatter-mean merged into any selected or recent position, so their K/V values need not remain unchanged.
lookm_budget.short_prompt_edge: If int(N*ratio)<=0, update_kv returns the uncompressed input. The k+32 formulas describe the long video prompts intended here.

hybridkv_kvrepack_budget.length_definition: N = complete inputs_embeds.shape[1] at cache construction, including expanded video tokens, text and special tokens.
hybridkv_kvrepack_budget.nominal_global_history_budget: 112*a (per sample, across all28 layers and4 native KV heads)
hybridkv_kvrepack_budget.head_allocation: HEAD_CLASSIFY=head_ada; BUDGET_METHOD=head_ada. Retrieval/dynamic heads receive a common retrieval budget; remaining global budget is divided over static/pruning heads using a fixed part and attention-score part.
hybridkv_kvrepack_budget.native_head_actual_history_budgets: b[l,h] = final sparse_budget_per_head[l][0][h], after allocation, capacity clipping and KVRepack retrieval8-slot alignment; do not infer every b from a alone.
hybridkv_kvrepack_budget.denominator_explanation: 112*N counts original uncompressed positions once per native KV head and layer; count a K/V position pair once. K and V tensors each occupy those positions. Byte accounting must additionally multiply dimensions/dtypes and include backing/index buffers.
hybridkv_kvrepack_budget.allocation_rounding_limits: Fixed-budget integer division can leave a remainder. Per-head sequence limits and final retrieval chunk clipping/alignment can change the actual sum. Thus 112*a is an allocation target, not an unconditional exact final identity.
hybridkv_kvrepack_budget.backing_storage_warning: Hybrid additionally retains retrieval history/backing caches and index metadata; active sparse decode cache capacity is not the total amount of live K/V storage or total GPU memory. Current GPU Hybrid path keeps retrieval backing tensors on the model device.

prompt_reset.persistent_field_limit: init_lookm sets config defaults only when absent; changing environment ratio on an existing model is insufficient. Its newly constructed cluster receives the current function mask arguments, so old config mask fields do not replace those arguments.
prompt_reset.recommendation: Run LookM and HybridKV+KVRepack in separate fresh processes/models. Use a fresh past_key_values cache per doc and reset model RoPE deltas and prompt-specific attention clusters; retain each native method class/dispatcher.

preserved_native_behavior_to_disclose.behavior: merge_kv flattens selected index membership across heads for torch.isin when constructing dropped positions, rather than a separate per-head membership test. This is shared by the inspected original and migrated implementation and was not repaired for this comparison.
Pivot cosine reshape assumes head_dim128; this matches the target7B native head dimension.

controller_review.note: Read-only review only; no child process was started. Worker not independently reviewed in this audit.

previous_nonblocking_resume_issue.issue: The scorer is skipped when the report directory exists, even if a previous interrupted/failed scoring attempt left no complete summary. A resume then fails on missing/noncomplete summary without re-running scoring.
previous_nonblocking_resume_issue.recommended_action: Use a validated complete summary as the skip criterion, and permit an incomplete report to be rebuilt or scored into a fresh atomic directory.

resume_issue_resolution.criterion: Only a readable report summary with status complete skips scoring. Incomplete report directories are preserved by rename before a new scoring attempt.
